tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: Decode a US vehicle VIN into specifications: year, make, model, trim, engine, drivetrain, fuel economy and dimensions. Free — does NOT include title, accident, odometer or ownership history.

tools.name: lookup_vehicle
tools.description: Start a VINSeeker vehicle history report for a VIN — accidents, title checks, mileage and ownership. Opens the report flow on vinseeker.com so the user can complete their purchase.
